verdicts.reason: A mixes alignments: the one-line headline is centred, but the CTA is pushed to the left edge (x≈28) and doesn't line up with the headline's start (≈40). The LIMITED badge sits loose to the right of the button. The headline is shrunk, so it carries less weight, and the bottom third is empty. B keeps the original's centred two-line headline at a strong size and keeps the badge+CTA grouping. Its flaws: the stack is top-heavy, with a tight top margin and empty space at the bottom; the headline sits too close to the CTA row; and the tiny LIMITED text is barely readable.
